title: Repository explanation, packet checking and generated navigation
objective: Provide deterministic repository explanation, packet validation and generated navigation without changing product runtime behavior.
acceptance: module and capability explanations are deterministic and fail closed for unknown targets
packet-check validates baseline, changed paths, affected closure, workflow selection and generated freshness
generated navigation uses deterministic ordering and source digests
no runtime route, contract, persistence, migration, dependency or product behavior changes
non_goals: Customer Privacy legal-hold or retention behavior
local lifecycle commands reserved for repository step 15
